name: D2 NLI grounding, fixed on Set A (Step 3)
formula: support := (1 - alpha) * ISSUP + alpha * g_mean; score = released - w_sup * ISSUP + w_sup * support
g_mean: mean over the candidate's ALCE sentences of DeBERTa P(entailment | own passage)
selection_rule: grounding/tune_ground.py docstring (fixed before the grid was run)

commands.set_B: python grounding/rerank_ground.py --f results/runs/asqa_cands_0_end.json --ground results/runs/cand_ground_B.jsonl --split critique/splits/asqa_B.json --mode mix --agg mean --param 0.75 --out out/rr_ground_B.json
commands.set_C: python grounding/rerank_ground.py --f results/runs/asqa_cands_C.json --ground results/runs/cand_ground_C.jsonl --split critique/splits/asqa_C.json --mode mix --agg mean --param 0.75 --out out/rr_ground_C.json
